intent: Let zsh users run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` by registering `_rg` with `compdef` when sourced, and document the option in the FAQ. Closes issue #2956.

findings.title: Sourcing before compinit still calls _rg and errors on every shell start
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the `(( ! $+functions[compdef] ))` fallback out of the interactive path: gate the direct `_rg "$@"` call on the test-harness case (for example `_RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS`) or make it a silent no-op, and have the FAQ say the `source` line must come after `compinit`.
findings.why_it_matters: The FAQ tells users to put `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` in `~/.zshrc` but never says it must come after `compinit`. If it comes first, `compdef` is undefined, the fallback branch runs `_rg` outside completion, and each new shell prints `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments`. This is the same class of startup error issue #2956 reported.
evidence: Ran `zsh -f -c 'source rg.zsh'` on the head file (zsh 5.8.1): it printed `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments`.
Ran source before `compinit` in a scratch script: the same error was printed.
With `compinit` first, `_comps[rg]` is `_rg` and there is no error.
The `! compdef` branch exists so ci/test-complete can source the file without the completion system (`( _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source $1 )`).

findings.title: FAQ zsh instructions: ordering and wording gaps
findings.suggested_fix: Reword to 'while this approach is easier to set up, it is generally slower than the previous method and adds time to shell startup'. Drop the leading `$` from the `.zshrc` snippet, as the adjacent fpath snippet does. Note that both the `fpath=` line and the `source` line must come before/after `compinit` respectively.
findings.first_evidence: Note though that while this approach is easier to setup, is generally slower
findings.why_it_matters: The sentence is ungrammatical (missing subject, 'setup' used as a verb). The `$ ` prompt inside a `.zshrc` snippet is a copy-paste hazard. The `fpath` line only takes effect if it runs before `compinit`, and the `source` line only works if it runs after `compinit`. Neither ordering is stated.
evidence: FAQ.md hunk in diff: `$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` inside a ```zsh block described as a `.zshrc` addition, next to an `fpath=(...)` block with no `$`.

residual_risks: The `$funcstack[1] == _rg` check was confirmed only for an fpath-autoloaded `_foo` stand-in under zsh 5.8.1, not the real `_rg` from a package install. Other zsh versions and plugin managers that source `_rg` from inside a function named `_rg` were not exercised.
ci/test-complete could not be run (needs a built rg). The fallback branch is inferred from reading that script.
testing_gaps: No automated check covers the new sourced-with-compdef branch; ci/test-complete only exercises the no-compdef path.

coverage.notes: Lite path ran in one context; no reviewer agents were dispatched and no validator ran. No CODING_STANDARDS.md, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md governs the changed files. No plan was found. Compound Packs, learnings, agent-native gaps and deployment notes were not assessed. Behavior checked with scratch zsh 5.8.1 scripts. Untracked files: none.
